notes.title: [Erase News Letter vol.14] Status Update and Release of Development Screenshots
notes.content:
Hello Players, 

In this letter, we would like to inform you of our development progress and our upcoming event participation.  

While it can be difficult to visually convey development progress, and some information cannot yet be disclosed, development is proceeding on a daily basis! 


- Persistent display of card effect targets during battle
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/0b0cdf7065c567233992f3522761b2429789aa32.gif"]

To address the issue that "it is difficult to tell what a card is targeting," we have made the target indicators persistently visible. 

When retargeting manually, non-selectable targets are dimmed to improve clarity.  


- Event participation announcement 
We will be participating in the indie game web-only event "EARLY TAKES" on October 4. https://event.toranoana.jp/web-only/312253/

We are preparing to make the exhibition demo playable online as well. Participation is free, so please feel free to drop by!   



Please look forward to it.   

We are continuing to work diligently on development, so if you haven't already, please add "Erase" to your wishlist and support us!

notes.title: [Erase News Letter vol.13]　Status Update and Release of Development Screenshots
notes.content:
Hello Players,

Today we participated in the indie game exhibition "Game Pavilion JP" held in Osaka, and visitors played the demo at our booth.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/f46796a7265abeef6be4b0fabe7ccff6946f2fb0.jpg"]

Thank you to everyone who stopped by despite the rain and for your valuable feedback. 

We will use the feedback we received to further refine the game. We will continue to improve, and we would be grateful for your continued support.



We are also sharing a preview of some screens currently under development:



- Begun English localization

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/f854ea22605a6c7abe57d8836bb1c984d148e8eb.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/f5787e625e39ce1e5400c7149289147147befb6d.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/df652b768394b5061845be894789a667526a8222.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/3f5c9fa834f7a8cfc9c97ecaa3e73115fb12848a.jpg"]

- Implemented a command to change characters' expressions during dialogue

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/7fbe45b455ff951cb4afa3c45bf05652c00e430b.gif"]

- Battle finish cinematics

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/feeb192a5aa8bf0052afd89b99576033c3c0e4e0.png"]

- Card pack opening animation

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/ffce97176789f0ef9a41e6bf3fdb0a9dffb2c8e6.png"]

Our next exhibition appearance is scheduled for this autumn. 

By then, we plan to deliver a version that is easier to play and features more polished presentation. 



Please look forward to it. 

We are continuing to work diligently on development, so if you haven't already, please add "Erase" to your wishlist and support us!
